## Overview

**Soren Kaien** — the monk leader of the Jade Wardens who looked over the East border of the continent during the era of the First Alliance. He was selected as one of the seven Alliance heroes entrusted with defeating Khar'Zul.

---

## Fate

Soren Kaien died in the first battle against Khar'Zul, alongside Edmund Drake.
